What I do:
Lua Code:
```
1. SetCVar ( 'useuiscale' , 1 )
2. SetCVar ( 'uiscale' , 1 )
3. local _, height = GetPhysicalScreenSize ( )
4. UIParent:SetScale ( 768 / height )
```

# GetPhysicalScreenSize
* [](https://mrbuds.github.io/wow-api-web/?search=api:function:GetPhysicalScreenSize:Screen) [/api addon](https://mrbuds.github.io/wow-api-web/?search=api:function:GetPhysicalScreenSize:Screen) |
|Patch |
|Added in 7.1.0 / 1.13.2 |
↑ _World of Warcraft API_
Returns physical screen size of game.
```
width , height = GetPhysicalScreenSize ()
```

## Returns
```
width
number \- game physical screen width.
```
height
number - game physical screen height.

## Patch changes
* **Patch 7.1.0 (2016-10-25):** Added.

# GetScreenWidth
↑ _World of Warcraft API_
Returns the width of the window measured at UIParent scale (effectively the same as UIParent:GetWidth().
```
screenWidth = GetScreenWidth()
```

## Returns
```
screenWidth
number \- Width of window at UIParent scale
```

## Example
```
-- Note that the return value does not match the screen resolution set in the Video Options, but will instead represent a dimension with the same aspect ratio. 
 DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME : AddMessage ( ( GetScreenWidth () * UIParent : GetEffectiveScale () ).. "x" .. ( GetScreenHeight () * UIParent : GetEffectiveScale () ) )
```
